purpose: Verified bibliographic records; these publisher pages are not additional eligible critical sources.

works.title: The Doll
works.description: A novel examining class, ambition and conflicting social ideals in nineteenth-century Warsaw.

edition.translation_notes: Publisher identifies this as its edition of the novel, with an introduction by Stanisław Barańczak. Revision history of the Welsh translation remains to be documented; no comparative claim of best translation is made.

works.bibliographic_caution: Do not infer original publication year from the 2011 edition date.

works.title: War and Peace
works.description: A novel combining social narrative, war and historical inquiry. The completed first book edition appeared in 1868–1869, following earlier serialization.

edition.translation_notes: Complete-novel translation; retains French passages with English footnotes. Figes praises repetition and register while noting individual errors. This is not Bromfield’s translation of an earlier, shorter draft.

works.bibliographic_caution: Original year records completion of the first book publication range, not first serialization.

works.title: Kokoro
works.description: A novel of friendship, guilt and generational change, with a younger narrator and an older figure called Sensei.

edition.translation_notes: English translation with introduction and notes by Meredith McKinney. The publisher page contains an unrelated author-biography block; that block was excluded from catalog research.

works.bibliographic_caution: Do not reuse the publisher’s incorrect claim that this was Sōseki’s last completed novel.

works.title: The Magic Mountain
works.description: A novel of time, illness and intellectual conflict set in a Swiss sanatorium before the First World War.

edition.translation_notes: Hardcover English edition with introduction by A. S. Byatt, bibliography and author chronology. The 904-page extent belongs to this hardcover, not the separately listed 720-page paperback. The earlier reader review R179 concerns Lowe-Porter, not Woods.

works.bibliographic_caution: The Nobel Prize was awarded to Mann’s work; do not record a book-specific Nobel award from the product badge.
